feature: U12 PR B · B+ share sheet: SHARE THIS SHOW eyebrow, boxed ×, ring-framed preview, SHAPE tiles with outline glyphs, gradient Share… with icon, Save image and Copy link side by side
note: Plan: b1-u12-plan.md §1 Sheet. Boards (design/design_handoff_bplus_redesign/screens/07-more-screens/): phone = more-r3-share_m (Wide selected), more-r3-share_m_square (Square selected); desktop = more-r3-share_d (Story selected, 440px centred dialog). Phone Story and desktop Square/Wide are undrawn; their rows check the drawn chrome only. The poster inside the ring is PR A's image route: until PR A lands it is the pre-B+ poster, which is expected. Share… only renders where navigator.share exists, so headless desktop Chromium may show Save image and Copy link alone. Walk by hand: Escape, Tab wrap inside the dialog, and a real Share… on an Android phone (twice in a row, to prove the click keeps its activation).
